title: What options you have when calling an Agent (Optional DeepDive)

cues.en: In this video we are going to look a little on all the different options we have when we call RunAsync.
cues.zh: 這段影片看看呼叫 RunAsync 時，有哪些不同選項。

cues.en: RunAsync and RunAsyncStreaming have exactly the same options so we will just cover RunAsync and we will keep RunAsync for structured output to its
cues.zh: RunAsync 和 RunStreamingAsync 的選項完全相同，所以只介紹 RunAsync。結構化輸出的泛型版本則留給

cues.en: own separate video.
cues.zh: 另一段專門影片。

cues.en: So when we do this we have a lot of options but behind the scenes it's actually not that much different.
cues.zh: 這裡看起來選項很多，但底層其實沒有那麼多差別。

cues.en: So let's go through them one by one.
cues.zh: 逐一看一下。

cues.en: So first up we can just give an 18 thread and nothing more.
cues.zh: 首先，可以只傳入 AgentThread，不提供其他內容。

cues.en: We can give the thread and options and throughout this we can give thread and options.
cues.zh: 也可以傳入 Thread 和 Options，很多多載都有這兩個參數。

cues.en: So the thread itself we saw is the one that keeps the persistence between the different calls and I know this specific overload is
cues.zh: Thread 如前面所見，會在不同呼叫之間保存對話。我也知道這個特定多載，

cues.en: actually something that the team is considering removing because it doesn't really make sense to just give a thread without a new message.
cues.zh: 團隊正考慮移除，因為只提供 Thread，卻沒有新訊息，實際上意義不大。

cues.en: But the thread itself we don't really do anything other than get it from the agent and then paste it in.
cues.zh: 不過 Thread 本身通常不用操作，只要從代理程式取得，再傳進去即可。

cues.en: The options might look a bit empty in that we can give some additional properties.
cues.zh: Options 看起來比較空，可以放一些 AdditionalProperties。

cues.en: In general there's always an additional property that can be used to put in new things at some point.
cues.zh: 一般來說，總會有這種額外屬性，方便未來加入新的設定。

cues.en: It doesn't really do anything for most of the providers but they have made it ready so it's possible.
cues.zh: 大多數供應商目前不會使用，但介面已經先準備好，讓之後能擴充。

cues.en: And then there's something called background responses.
cues.zh: 接著是 BackgroundResponses。

cues.en: It's a very very niche feature that needs a continuation token in order to be able to make everything happen in the background and
cues.zh: 這是一項非常特殊的功能，需要 ContinuationToken，才能在背景處理，

cues.en: with long streaming.
cues.zh: 並支援長時間的串流。

cues.en: I don't think even I will cover this in this because it's so advanced but I actually have a video I will link to in the system if you really want to
cues.zh: 這部分相當進階，我可能不會在本課完整介紹，但會附上另外一段影片的連結，如果你真的想

cues.en: see what this is about.
cues.zh: 了解它的用途，可以參考。

cues.en: Beyond that we can actually give when we have a chat client instead of an agent run options we can give a chat client agent run options instead and have a bit
cues.zh: 此外，如果使用 ChatClientAgent，除了 AgentRunOptions，也可以傳入 ChatClientAgentRunOptions，取得

cues.en: more features in that it can give some chat options similar to what we did up in the agent itself.
cues.zh: 更多功能，例如提供和建立代理程式時類似的 ChatOptions。

cues.en: So we can under fly switch to a different instruction, switch to a different temperature, switch to some other tools.
cues.zh: 因此可以在呼叫當下，動態換指示、換 Temperature，或換工具。

cues.en: So let's say we have an agent that has three tools but in this specific call you only want to give two.
cues.zh: 例如代理程式原本有三個工具，但這次呼叫只想提供其中兩個，

cues.en: That is possible so it can overwrite the stuff here.
cues.zh: 就能在這裡覆寫設定。

cues.en: And beyond that it also has the client factory which is the slow level thing of being able to manipulate the underlying agents.
cues.zh: 另外還有 ClientFactory，可以在底層操作實際使用的用戶端。

cues.en: So those was the the thread and the options.
cues.zh: 以上就是 Thread 和 Options。

cues.en: There's a cancellation token, gives itself.
cues.zh: CancellationToken 的用途就和一般 .NET 程式相同。

cues.en: There's serialisation options whenever there's some serialisation back and forward.
cues.zh: 還有序列化選項，控制資料來回序列化的方式。

cues.en: That's mostly again to do with structured output which we will talk about later.
cues.zh: 這主要和結構化輸出有關，後面會再介紹。

cues.en: Then we have the various versions of giving it as a message.
cues.zh: 接著是各種傳入訊息的方式。

cues.en: So we can either give it as a chat message, a list of chat messages.
cues.zh: 可以傳入 ChatMessage，或一串 ChatMessage。

cues.en: Get this for me.
cues.zh: 例如這裡輸入「幫我取得這個」。

cues.en: So either messages, chat messages, collection of chat messages or down here we have all the
cues.zh: 所以可以是單一訊息、ChatMessage、ChatMessage 集合，或是下面把各種

cues.en: things happening together.
cues.zh: 參數組合在一起的多載。

cues.en: So it looks much.
cues.zh: 看起來很多，

cues.en: In reality you mostly will just give a message and an agent thread and that's it.
cues.zh: 但實際上，大多只需要傳入一則訊息和 AgentThread。

cues.en: It is very, very rare that you need to do more than that but the options are there.
cues.zh: 很少需要更多設定，不過這些選項都已經提供給你使用。
